ambient_computing.definition: Computing woven into the environment so that it acts in the background without demanding attention.

bell.definition: The small metal thing on a bicycle that makes a sound when you press it. Nam's bell is old and a bit tired.
bell.example: He pressed the bell three times before the wings moved.

gem_emotional_maturity.definition: The capacity to stay in charge of your own reactions when the other person is difficult.
gem_emotional_maturity.example: Her emotional maturity showed in the pause before she answered, not in the answer itself.

ghosting.definition: Stopping all contact without explanation, so the other person is left waiting and guessing.
ghosting.example: He replied for three weeks and then ghosted me completely.

pillow.definition: The soft thing under your head when you sleep in bed.
pillow.example: My pillow is soft and white.

psy_social_proof.definition: A pressure tactic that presents the decisions of other people as evidence for your own.
psy_social_proof.example: The offer came with social proof: nine out of ten customers chose the larger plan.
